summary: IHG filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that PDMR Byron Grote, a Non-Executive Director, acquired 250 American Depositary Receipts at $153.85 on 2026-09-11 on the NYSE, an aggregate of $38,462.50, under the UK Market Abuse Regulation's standard PDMR notification requirement. No board recommendation, advisor, stake change, premium, or structural terms are stated. This is a routine insider dealing disclosure involving a sitting board member, not a special situation; the only angle is trivial signaling value of small open-market director buying.
